gloss: power distribution line; electrical distribution line

definitions.gloss: power distribution line; electrical distribution line
definitions.explanation: The electrical lines that carry power from substations to homes and buildings. These are the lower-voltage lines commonly seen running along streets on utility poles, as distinct from high-voltage transmission lines.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{配電線|はいでんせん}が{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The distribution line was severed by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {配電線|はいでんせん}の{工事|こうじ}で{一時的|いちじてき}に{停電|ていでん}になる。
examples.english: There will be a temporary power outage due to distribution line work.

examples.japanese: {老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{配電線|はいでんせん}を{地中|ちちゅう}に{埋設|まいせつ}する{計画|けいかく}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Plans are progressing to bury aging distribution lines underground.

notes:
A compound of {配電|はいでん} (power distribution) and {線|せん} (line, wire). In the electrical grid, power flows from generators through {送電線|そうでんせん} (transmission lines) to substations, then through {配電線|はいでんせん} (distribution lines) to end users. The distribution lines are the ones most visible in daily life, running along {電柱|でんちゅう} (utility poles).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配電線|はいでんせん}の{修理|しゅうり}: repair of distribution lines
- {配電線|はいでんせん}の{地中化|ちちゅうか}: undergrounding of distribution lines
- {配電線|はいでんせん}が{断線|だんせん}する: a distribution line breaks
- {高圧|こうあつ}{配電線|はいでんせん}: high-voltage distribution line

RELATED WORDS:
- {送電線|そうでんせん}: transmission line — the high-voltage lines that carry power over long distances
- {電線|でんせん}: electrical wire — the general term for any electrical cable
- {電柱|でんちゅう}: utility pole — the poles that support distribution lines
